target.description: URL to check when none is given on the command line, e.g. http://localhost:3000

pages.description: Paths to check on the target site. Default: ["/"]

rules.description: Per check: "off" skips it and leaves it out of the score, "warn" reports a failure without failing the run, "error" (the default) fails the run.

failOn.description: "fail" (default): only failing checks fail the run. "warn": warnings fail it too.

minScore.description: The lowest passing score, 0-100. A page that scores less fails the run; a page that scores exactly this passes. 100 allows only a perfect score.

ratchet.description: Keep a score floor in ai-readiness.baseline.json that only goes up. A run fails if the score drops below it or a check gets worse.

tolerance.description: Points the score may drop below the floor before the run fails. Default: 0

name.description: Name of this floor in the baseline file, so staging and production can keep separate floors. Default: "default"
